comments.author: J***e
comments.content: Okay, So I got the Package, But Seriously, Could've been Handled Better. Like Most Other Comments here, The Box Came In All Banged Up. Luckily the Controller Was still in one piece, and so is the Phone Clip and Wire. The Controller Seems to have a slight issue with the Left Joystick, however, as Moving the Joystick up first reads it as moving left for a split second before affixing itself back to going up. This was made apparent when I played some games with the Onscreen Touch Joystick still visible and moving the left joystick on the gamepad. A bit of Proper Alignment needed but not intrusive. Overall, Pretty Okay. Important Notice to All: Using a Mediatek Processor Device does not Bar you from using the Gamepad in any known way. however, to play Certain Shooter and MOBA games (I.E. PUBG, MobLeg, Freefire, Etc.), You'll need to be set on Shooting plus V3 Mode (Hold A + HOME to turn on that mode ) and you'll need to use a Keymapper App (Preferred Octopus Controller App) to set up the Buttons before play. For Certain Colsole Emulators and Certain Games (I.E. Dead Cells, Terraria), You'll need to use Android Standard Mode (X + HOME when turning on). Overall, Good Controller, Subpar Packaging. 😅
